title: Austin's Nuclear Project & Manager Review
summary:
*   **City Manager's Future:** Council members met privately to evaluate the City Manager's job performance and discuss potential changes to their compensation.
*   **South Texas Project:** A significant portion of the closed-door meeting focused on the "South Texas Project," encompassing pending litigation and real estate transactions, likely related to the nuclear power plant.
*   **No Public Action Taken:** Despite these key private discussions, the special meeting concluded without any public votes or policy decisions being made on any of the agenda items.
